IMPLEMENTED AND PUSHED: Gerrit change 1160. workflow_ops.py 794 -> 511 (target was <= 560);
decide_ops.py 349 LOC.

HELD-OUT TDD held: I authored 7 tests, confirmed RED, handed the implementer only the 3 happy-path
cases, and it passed all 4 it never saw — the leaf check, the attribute-access guard, the seam-bound
tightening, and the registration-location check.

MUTATIONS, and one of them TAUGHT ME SOMETHING rather than merely confirming:
  M1 flatten the orchestrator import -> 1 test FAILS. Good: that is the silent-break mode, where the
     lifecycle test's monkeypatch of orchestrator.pass3_over_findings still applies to the module
     while the flattened name holds the original function, so the test passes while exercising
     unpatched code.
  M2 drop the `from . import decide_ops as _decide_ops` registration import -> NOTHING FAILED.
     I expected a red and did not get one. The reason is not a weak guard: workflow_ops also does
     `from .decide_ops import (...)` for the re-exports, and THAT import already executes the module,
     so registration happens regardless. My mutation did not create a defect, so there was nothing
     to catch. The dedicated registration import for decide_ops is therefore REDUNDANT — harmless
     and idempotent, but it is the re-export that actually guarantees registration here, and if the
     re-export were ever removed the re-export test fails first.
  M3 the VALID form of that mutation -> drop the `prerequisite_workflow_ops` side-effect import,
     which is NOT re-exported and is registered by side effect alone. TWO of d8ef's guards fail:
     the registry-membership check and the gate-YAML resolution check. That is the cross-ticket
     proof that d8ef's guards catch a real defect in this ticket's file.

I am recording M2 as a non-result rather than quietly dropping it, because "the mutation did not bite"
is exactly the observation that would otherwise be reported as "mutations confirmed". The guard is
sound; my mutation was not a defect.

GATES: make lint clean, make typecheck clean (407 files). The implementer's full-suite run reported
8308 passed / 74 skipped / 0 failed with ZERO edits to any existing test file beyond the single seam
constant this plan mandates — the zero-test-edit property that the plan names as the revert signal.

NOT CLOSING until 1160 is Verified +1.
